item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, it will become fine and hot over southern China in the next couple of days. The northeast monsoon is expected to persist over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be windy over the region.

Date/Month: 02/10 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 03/10 (Monday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine apart from one or two showers. Hot during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
